name: FrontierCO-Train
description: FrontierCO-Train is a training split for the FrontierCO dataset intended to support chain-of-thought / reasoning model training and evaluation. It provides examples and annotations aimed at improving multi-step reasoning capabilities in language models.
evaluation_method: accuracy (task-specific correctness) and qualitative assessment of chain-of-thought outputs
general_score_metric: accuracy (often measured on held-out reasoning tasks / correctness of final answer)
reputation: A specialized dataset in the CO-Bench family aimed at improving reasoning via chain-of-thought; adoption is growing among researchers focusing on reasoning training but not yet a community standard.
